question: Which core courses are scheduled in Quarter 1 of the sample part-time program?

pipeline_flatrag.answer:
Based on the retrieved context, the core courses scheduled in Quarter 1 of the sample part-time program are:
- Statistical Models for Data Science [Core, Letter Grade, 10 Weeks]

Note: The other courses listed for Quarter 1 (Python for Data Science and Advanced Linear Algebra for Machine Learning) are foundational/optional, not core courses [1].
